source_id.description: Non-semantic 12-char lowercase hex id. Must not be derived from titles or author names.

source_fingerprint.description: Versioned SHA-256 of normalized source text used by downstream evidence references.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original input file bytes; retained in the private run only.

model_processing.description: User-consented model processing scope for this source.

derivative_use.description: Allowed derivative use for downstream artifacts.

evidence_basis.description: Basis recorded for the user's model-processing consent. System does not independently verify legal rights.

authorization_type.description: Top-level mirror of authorization.evidence_basis for auditing the model-processing consent record.

declared_derivative_use.description: Effective derivative-use scope; private_only is the default, while shareable scopes require explicit authorization.

retention_until.description: Pointer to the retention record; never carries the source body.
